findings.statement: This is a new warning. The rise in value at risk came almost entirely from the market data window, most likely a large loss entering the sample, while position changes slightly reduced it.
The expected shortfall warning continues and worsened, moving closer to the hard limit but not through it. This is consistent with the heavier loss tail in the data window.
The volatility breach continues and volatility rose further after a large negative portfolio return on the day. It is well beyond the hard limit.
The drawdown breach continues and deepened because the portfolio lost value on the day, after a gain the day before. Net asset value fell from the prior day.

The backtest shows more value at risk exceptions than expected, including one today, and the tests reject both correct coverage and independence. The model may be understating risk, so the value at risk warning should not be read as a ceiling on losses.
